headline: First-home buyers withdraw record $296m from KiwiSaver
caption: Big news for first-home buyers in East Auckland! KiwiSaver early withdrawals hit a new monthly high of $296 million in March, showing many Kiwis are tapping into their savings to get into the property market. If you're saving for your first home or thinking about your next move, this trend reflects just how motivated buyers are right now—and why it's a great time to talk strategy with us. 🏡
original_title: Early KiwiSaver withdrawals hit new monthly high, topping $296m in March
